title: Sports and Music
text:
My name is Tom. I like sports very much. I play football on Saturday with my friends. We play in the park.

My sister Anna likes music. She plays the piano every day. In the evening, she reads books. On Sunday, we go to the swimming pool together.

questions.text: Why does Tom play football with his friends?
options: Because he wants to read books

questions.text: How does Anna probably feel about music?

vocabulary.definition: a game played with a round ball by two teams
a large public area with grass and trees
a large musical instrument with black and white keys
with another person or other people

paragraph_translations: Мене звати Том. Я дуже люблю спорт. У суботу я граю у футбол з друзями. Ми граємо в парку.
Моя сестра Анна любить музику. Вона грає на фортепіано щодня. Ввечері вона читає книжки. У неділю ми разом ідемо до басейну.
